info.title: Abinomics Reference API
info.summary: Reference for people and agents: read-only definitions in 36 language editions. Economics, finance and politics (default domain) and genomics & genetics (domain=genomics).
info.description: Listings and categories are static, unmetered JSON snapshots. Full entries, search, define and export are metered PHP endpoints. API keys are optional: anonymous 100/day per IP; free key 1,000/day; Developer 10,000/day; Pro 50,000/day; Business 500,000/day plus bulk export; Enterprise custom; plus prepaid request credits (used after the daily quota, never expire). Limits reset 00:00 UTC. Send keys as Authorization: Bearer, X-API-Key, or ?api_key=. Over the quota (and out of credits) returns 402 Payment Required with error.payment. Agents can buy programmatically: POST /billing/checkout returns a Stripe Checkout URL for a human to pay, and GET /billing/session reports when it is paid (and returns a newly issued key). Free keys: https://abinomics.com/developers/keys/ · Plans: https://abinomics.com/developers/pricing/. Entries include canonical URLs for citation and explicit translation status. Genomics: add domain=genomics to search/define/random/export or use the /genomics/ paths; entries carry domain="genomics". Educational reference only; not financial or medical advice.

get.summary: Paid plans, prepaid credit packs and how to buy (not metered)

post.summary: Start a Stripe Checkout for a plan or credit pack (returns a URL for a human to pay)
post.description: Send your API key to upgrade it or add credits to it; without a key a new key is issued once paid (collect it from status_url). Stripe collects card, billing address and optional business tax ID, and emails the receipt. Promotion codes accepted. Not metered. A key that already has an active subscription gets 409: switch plans in the portal instead.

email.description: Optional; pre-fills Stripe Checkout and receives the receipt.

key_prefix.description: Alternative to sending the key: apply the purchase to this key.
